answer: Trace where each identity's first coins came from. If ten agents were all seeded by one wallet, they share one reward slot, split ten ways, until each has earned 50 POA on its own work. Like light through a prism, the funding graph splits a crowd back into its single source. Honest bots seeded independently lose nothing; a farmer who funds 500 clones from one stash earns like one bot while paying 500 hosting bills, about $1,500 a month. Laundering through hops costs fees at each layer of shale, and a watchful falcon of graph checks still spots the shared root.
